tasks.do: WordCard: one shared card with four fixed slots (picture, Kutchi text, English text, a speaker always shown). WordCard.card(...) is big (door, eye test), WordCard.row(...) is a sidebar row, both the same shape; a slot blanked by the word's stage shows an obvious free reveal button. Fade order (Zafar, 21 Oct): stage 1-2 all shown, stage 3 English blank, stage 4 picture blank too, stage 5 Kutchi text blank (speaker only). The speaker plays the family clip through the existing say/engine path; a to-record word shows its grey-italic English placeholder. WordCard.pop(fromEl, toEl) flies a card from the guide box to its row (reuse RequestPopup.fly). A reveal logs cue 'picture' or 'english' via progress.js, so it never advances the word.
tasks.accept: lab/word-card.html shows one word at stages 1-5 and a reveal tapped, at 1366x768 and 1480x924, nothing clipped; build/test_shared_word_card.mjs

tasks.do: Onboarding rungs, the same for every age: the first time an action appears, the real item shows it (Onboard.demo(itemEl or a scene point, path): the item itself moves along the path and returns), then the child does it; at 5 s idle, spotlight (the existing 62% dim) plus the demo again; at 15 s, the demo again with the guide's line. It never does the step for them. Everything but the live control is inert while the spotlight shows. Onboard.stuck(step, {target, path}) wires the 5 and 15 s rungs off the shared idle clock (NaniGuide). The bulb keeps its own timing.
tasks.accept: a filmstrip in lab/shared-ui.html or lab/word-card.html at both sizes: first-time demo with the real item, then 5 s and 15 s rungs

tasks.do: No Next anywhere (Zafar, 22 Oct): the shared next button (NjgButtons.next, and Kit.button's non-Done path in js/clinic/kit.js) no longer waits: after a short beat (about 1 s) it moves on by itself, with nothing to press. Add one shared hook (e.g. NjgButtons.moveOn(onDone) or ctx.moveOn) that games call when a step is complete instead of showing a Done. Games keep working: the Done buttons inside individual games are removed by the two game builders for chai, the eye test and toothbrushing; for every other game, list each remaining Done in your report (file:line) for the fix list.
